metadata.description: Skills personales para Claude Code: el plugin `toolkit` las trae todas, o instala cada skill por separado

plugins.name: toolkit
plugins.description: Every personal skill in one plugin: how-to-chrome (drive the user's real Chrome via CDP), grill-me (stress-test a plan through questions), daily-journal (time-aware development journaling), obsidian-vault (personal markdown notes folder), test-driven-development (Logic Gate + Iron Rule TDD), and i-have-adhd (ADHD-friendly output style).

plugins.name: how-to-chrome
plugins.description: Control the user's real Google Chrome (their profile, cookies and logged-in sessions) from the terminal via the Chrome DevTools Protocol: navigate, capture (incl. full page and per breakpoint), read console/DOM, fill forms, export to PDF, annotate elements, and group tabs. No extension, no MCP, no npm dependencies.

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding, resolving each branch of the decision tree with a recommended answer at every question.

plugins.name: daily-journal
plugins.description: Time-aware conversational development journal (morning=planning, evening=reflection). Writes structured markdown; Obsidian optional. Ported from ravila4/claude-adhd-skills.

plugins.name: obsidian-vault
plugins.description: Folder structure, naming and formatting conventions for a personal markdown notes folder (Obsidian-compatible, Obsidian itself optional). Ported from ravila4/claude-adhd-skills.

plugins.name: test-driven-development
plugins.description: Logic Gate + Iron Rule: triage what actually needs tests, then strict test-first development for anything with logic. Ported from ravila4/claude-adhd-skills.

plugins.name: i-have-adhd
plugins.description: Shape Claude Code output for an ADHD reader: lead with the next action, number steps, suppress tangents, restate state, make wins visible. Ported from ayghri/i-have-adhd.
